abuse.","Xi's Xinjiang endorsement is the strongest attribution item, but the linkage between the 2023 visit, specific policies, and underlying abuses remains incompletely documented.","Evidence on separation."]},{"attribution_risk":"high","chapter_id":"4B","defensible_evidence_estimate":13,"independent_source_family_estimate":6,"missing_themes":["4B.1","4B.2","4B.4","4B.7"],"substantive_issues":["Freedom partly inherited; contrary evidence on participation and institutional constraints is incomplete.","The chapter still contains environmental facts, such as platform exits and Hong Kong conditions, chain."]},{"attribution_risk":"high","chapter_id":"5B","defensible_evidence_estimate":12,"independent_source_family_estimate":7,"missing_themes":["5B.2","5B.3","5B.4","5B.5","5B.7","5B.8","5B.9","5B.10"],"substantive_issues":["World responsibility.","Distribution, employment quality, public-service access, private-sector treatment, and regional inequality remain incomplete.","Several claims still derive from one China Briefing personal-integrity evidence.","Evidence of assets, conflicts, procurement, truthful public claims, contrary conduct, and independent scrutiny remains missing and strength or effectiveness must not enter judging."]}],"global_findings":["All eight chapters retain material, research-recoverable gaps and should continue; no chapter has a credible saturation or access-blocker explanation sufficient to stop research.","The new primary and institutional sources improve temporal anchoring and source quality, but country-level, institutional, and subordinate conduct is still repeatedly linked to Xi through office-holding authority alone.","Gateway, aggregator, snippet, and same-family duplicates remain in the handoff. Wikipedia pages, CCDI/China Daily reporting, repeated local indicators, and cross-chapter copies must not inflate independent evidence estimates.","The notebook still contains bundled claims, incomplete precise locators, and researcher-written evaluative or saturation language. These are cleanup issues where factual support exists, but unresolved attribution and missing event themes require research continuation.","Missing evidence is not negative ruler evidence; the remaining gaps should lower evidentiary confidence rather than determine any chapter judgment."],"needs_continuation":true,"reviewer_summary":"Continuation improved target-period source coverage across all chapters, especially through DoD, OHCHR, Citizen Lab, World Bank, IMF, UNICEF, WHO, NBS, and official transcript material.
